description: This file defines a controller class 'SaveQualificationSkillController' within the OrangeHRM system, handling pre-render logic for qualification skill save/edit views. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages Vue component instantiation based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationSkillController
classes.description: Controller for handling the save or edit operation of qualification skills, determines which Vue component to render based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the appropriate Vue component ('qualification-skill-edit' or 'qualification-skill-save') based on whether an 'id' is present in the request attributes.
